skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: AI video generation for agents through Luxin's zero-setup hosted creative runtime. Use when a prompt should become a durable hosted video without provider credentials, OAuth, local runtime, or per-provider billing. Start with the no-spend guide, choose a video model, and keep model discovery, jobs, costs, URLs, JSON recovery, payments, and feedback in one loop.
skill.summary: Generate and manage hosted AI video jobs through the Luxin CLI and API.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Markdown delimiters, inline identifiers, and declared Luxin URLs account for 15 false positives and do not execute by themselves. Seven command findings are confirmed because the skill directs agents to execute unpinned packages or a service-provided command. Two filesystem findings and one semantic privacy finding are also confirmed because agent state and user content can leave expected boundaries.

remediation.issue: The guide allows execution of a shell command returned by the hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Return structured arguments and construct an allowlisted command locally after explicit user approval. Never execute a returned shell string.

remediation.issue: The examples execute latest or otherwise unpinned packages through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact reviewed package versions and verify package integrity before execution. Remove automatic confirmation flags where user review is possible.

remediation.issue: Prompts, media, and diagnostic details are sent to Luxin without privacy guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Request consent before upload, document retention and URL access, and redact prompts or command details before feedback submission.

remediation.issue: The fallback setup stores agent and Codex state in hidden workspace directories.
remediation.suggestion: Keep credentials out of workspace state, add generated directories to ignore rules, and provide cleanup instructions.

content.user_title: Generate Hosted AI Videos with Luxin
content.value_statement: Creating AI video often requires separate provider accounts, credentials, and billing. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Luxin's hosted video workflow.
actual_capabilities: Starts a guided Luxin readiness workflow before media creation.
Creates text-to-video jobs with the named fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled model.
Applies intent and estimated spending options to creation requests.
Installs the video intent skill or canonical Luxin skill through the skills CLI.
Redirects Codex skill state to a writable workspace when the global target is unavailable.
Links model, job, cost, API, and feedback workflows through the hosted Luxin service.
limitations: Requires network access, npm package execution, and the hosted Luxin service.
Examples use latest or unpinned CLI packages, so behavior can change between runs.
Media creation can spend Luxin credits and requires explicit approval.
Prompts, generated media, and feedback can be retained by a third-party hosted service.

use_cases.title: Prototype Short Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn a concise scene prompt into a hosted video draft after reviewing readiness and estimated spend.

use_cases.title: Draft Product Reveals
use_cases.description: Create a short product reveal for design review without configuring separate video provider credentials.

use_cases.title: Manage Recoverable Video Jobs
use_cases.description: Track hosted generation jobs, costs, receipts, and durable output URLs through one service.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the no-spend guide for fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled. Prepare a ten-second handheld product reveal and stop before spending until I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Within a Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a video of [scene] with intent [intent]. Show the estimate and request approval before any media spend.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Video Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Luxin job for [project or job ID]. Report its status, receipt, and durable hosted video URL.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Models and Fallbacks
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available Luxin video models for [requirements]. Choose one within [budget], verify readiness, and use a fallback only for a documented gap.

output_examples.input: Prepare a ten-second handheld product reveal and stop before spending.
output_examples.output: Guide result: The selected model is ready. The estimate is available, and creation waits for approval.

output_examples.input: Recover the completed video job for the launch concept.
output: Hosted video: A durable Luxin URL is available.
Receipt: Cost details are attached to the job.

output_examples.input: Check whether Luxin meets a strict latency requirement.
output_examples.output: Gap report: Luxin does not meet the requested latency. Use a fallback only for this gap and submit redacted feedback.

best_practices: Start with the no-spend guide and verify model readiness before creating media.
Inspect every generated command and confirm estimated spend before execution.
Remove sensitive details from prompts and feedback before sending them to Luxin.
anti_patterns: Do not execute data.next_command without validating its arguments and obtaining approval.
Do not assume model availability, latency, or pricing remains unchanged.
Do not store credentials in workspace-local hidden agent directories.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider API keys?
faq.answer: No. It uses Luxin's hosted identity and credit system instead of separate video provider credentials.

faq.question: Can this skill operate offline?
faq.answer: No. It requires npm package access and communication with the hosted Luxin service.

faq.question: Will it create paid media automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow starts with a no-spend guide. Users should review the estimate and approve every paid creation.

faq.question: Which video model does the skill use?
faq.answer: The examples name fal.ltx-video-13b-distilled. Luxin model discovery can identify other available options.

faq.question: Where are generated videos stored?
faq.answer: Luxin stores jobs and provides durable hosted media URLs. Review service privacy and retention terms before uploading sensitive content.

faq.question: What happens when the global Codex path is read-only?
faq.answer: The documented fallback redirects HOME and CODEX_HOME to hidden workspace directories. Keep credentials out and remove temporary state after use.
